entry_thesis: Microsoft is down ~25% from its November 2025 peak despite reporting a landmark Q2 FY2026 — $81.3B revenue (+17% YoY), Azure +39%, EPS $4.14 beating estimates by 7%, and $625B RPO backlog (+110% YoY). Market punished it for high CapEx ($29.88B, +89% YoY) but spending IS generating returns. The Great Rotation narrative has consensus fleeing tech, creating maximum pessimism in a world-class compounder at ~23x forward earnings — cheapest in 3 years.
risk: If CapEx accelerates further without proportional Azure revenue acceleration, market sentiment stays negative and the Great Rotation keeps the stock cheap longer.
catalyst: Q3 FY2026 earnings (April/May 2026) expected to show Azure growth sustaining at 38-40%+, forcing market to re-rate CapEx as growth investment
